name: Methane (CH4) Pressurized Leak
description: High concentration pressurized flammable gas leak detected adjacent to primary storage tanks.
recommendedAction: Immediate facility evacuation, deploy emergency nitrogen purge, isolate valve B-12.

name: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Toxic Discharge
description: Lethal toxic sour gas accumulation detected in low-lying welding bay drainage trench.
recommendedAction: Equip SCBA breathing gear immediately, activate overhead extraction blowers.

name: Carbon Monoxide (CO) Incomplete Combustion
description: Rising asphyxiant gas concentration detected from faulty boiler intake ventilation duct.
recommendedAction: Inspect boiler burners, verify intake dampeners, issue yellow alert to gallery crew.

name: Volatile Organic Compounds (VOC) Solvent Spill
description: Vapor plume originating from overturned degreaser drums.
recommendedAction: Apply absorbent sand, shut off ignition sources, check drone spark arrestor.
